dialogue.content: Long day. Just want to unwind before the sprint kicks off tomorrow.
Sounds like a lot on your plate. Anything you are looking forward to this sprint?
Mostly shipping the auth cleanup. Hoping it stays quiet otherwise.
Weird thing lately — I keep getting these dull headaches when I am up before six for the early calls.
That sounds draining. Do they ease off later in the day?
Yeah by noon I am fine. It is just the early part that wrecks me.
Finally repainted the spare room. Went with a deep green.
Deep green is a great choice — cozy. How does it feel in there now?
Calmer somehow. Good place to think.
Trying to eat out less this month, cooking more.
Nice goal. Any dishes you have been rotating?
Mostly stir-fry and simple pasta. Nothing fancy.
It is 1am and honestly this is my zone. I shipped the whole auth refactor between midnight and three — brain just clicks then.
You clearly do deep work late. That is a real strength.
Yeah, daytime meetings just scatter me.
Booked a trip for May, first real break in a while.
You have earned it. Somewhere relaxing?
Coastal town, quiet. No agenda.
Manager keeps floating internal moves. Feels like reshuffling season.
Plenty of options can be good or noisy. Want to talk through any of them later?
Maybe. I will wait until something concrete lands.

My manager offered to move me onto the platform pod. Only catch is they run a mandatory daily 7am standup. She wants to know if I would thrive there. What do you think based on what you know about me?
